correctness.rationale: The frame-power inclusion follows by a direct countervaluation. The critical m-path count converges by factorial moments; every overlapping component has excess arc count giving vanishing expectation. All critical m-walks are isolated paths, and no longer walk remains, so exactly one arc per component is necessary and sufficient, with m choices. The off-critical regimes follow first/second moment bounds and dense internally-disjoint paths. Exhaustive low-order checker tests corroborate finite claims only.
